Shanda Payment Holdings LTD Lowered Kkr & Co LP Del (KKR) Holding by $4.20 Million; Market Value Declined; Healthcare Tr Amer (HTA) Holder Honeywell International Upped Its Stake 
April 15, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney 
Honeywell International Inc increased its stake in Healthcare Tr Amer Inc (HTA) by 27.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Honeywell International Inc bought 19,085 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 87,521 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.63M, up from 68,436 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Honeywell International Inc who had been investing in Healthcare Tr Amer Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.27 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.41% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $25.19. About 1.24 million shares traded. Healthcare Trust of America, Inc. (NYSE:HTA) has declined 18.06% since April 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.61% the S&P500. 
Shanda Payment Holdings Ltd decreased its stake in Kkr & Co LP Del (KKR) by 8.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Shanda Payment Holdings Ltd sold 200,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.05M shares of the investment managers company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $43.13 million, down from 2.25 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Shanda Payment Holdings Ltd who had been investing in Kkr & Co LP Del for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $16.73 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.21% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $20.33. About 1.70 million shares traded. KKR & Co. L.P. (NYSE:KKR) has risen 15.21% since April 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 3.66% the S&P500.

(NYSE:HTA) earned “Buy” rating by TheStreet on Friday, October 16. The stock of Healthcare Trust of America, Inc. (NYSE:HTA) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Wednesday, December 9. The firm earned “Strong Buy” rating on Monday, July 17 by Raymond James. On Thursday, February 15 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, January 4 by Mizuho. The rating was upgraded by Stifel Nicolaus to “Buy” on Wednesday, August 26. On Monday, March 26 the stock rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Buy”. The stock has “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Monday, March 26. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, August 2 by Oppenheimer. SunTrust maintained the shares of HTA in report on Tuesday, October 24 with “Buy” rating. 
Honeywell International Inc, which manages about $3.02 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Comcast Corp (NASDAQ:CMCSA) by 549,200 shares to 968,800 shares, valued at $38.80 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM) by 29,700 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 450,300 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 13 analysts covering Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. ( NYSE:KKR ), 9 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 69% are positive. The rating was maintained by Keefe Bruyette & Woods with “Buy” on Thursday, September 28. Wood maintained it with “Market Perform” rating and $20 target in Monday, July 11 report. Morgan Stanley maintained the stock with “Equal-Weight” rating in Tuesday, April 26 report. As per Tuesday, April 10, the company rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Friday, March 11 by Deutsche Bank. The rating was maintained by Standpoint Research with “Hold” on Sunday, August 9. On Monday, May 29 the stock rating was maintained by Keefe Bruyette & Woods with “Buy”. The rating was upgraded by Goldman Sachs on Tuesday, January 9 to “Buy”. Morgan Stanley maintained KKR & Co. L.P. (NYSE:KKR) on Thursday, October 5 with “Equal-Weight” rating. 
Analysts await KKR & Co. L.P. (NYSE:KKR) to report earnings on April, 26. They expect $0.61 EPS, down 6.15% or $0.04 from last year’s $0.65 per share. KKR’s profit will be $501.89M for 8.33 P/E if the $0.61 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.48 actual EPS reported by KKR & Co. L.P. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 27.08% EPS growth.
